scope: P8.0 workload and measurement contract only; no runtime/tooling acceptance

source_lock.working_tree: clean at P8.0 inspection; this manifest is a subsequent documentation change
source_lock.database_schema: unverified; source migration level does not establish actual fixture/shared DB state

fingerprint_policy.source: record full git revision and SHA-256 of dirty-source material (status, diff, sorted untracked path/content); clean source records revision and clean status
fingerprint_policy.images: record immutable image reference and inspected image ID for every service; tags alone are not fingerprints
fingerprint_policy.missing: use null plus a qualification reason; never synthesize a hash or merge unlike source/image qualifications

historical_gates_not_reexecuted: P7 full Python discovery: 3 failures and 4 errors, historically classified as environment/trusted-ancestor issues; not rerun for P7.11
P7 full/remote CI, HIL/AM5728, P8 capacity/soak and live rollout: NOT RUN
P7 native raw lanes retain full_p7_accepted=false; the aggregate source-qualified status is not a full acceptance

topology.machine_a: one active backend with fixture DB, broker, Auth and Nginx; privileged collectors remain on A
topology.machine_b: Python coordinator and bounded Go load generators; only role-scoped client credentials, no DB/admin/Docker access
topology.colocated_result_qualification: tool/path pilot only, not split-machine capacity evidence

measurement.sample_profile_note: 1 sample/message is a distinct raw telemetry workload, not FFT/min-max/avg or downsampling

clocks.server: process-local monotonic durations for queues, persistence, confirmed-commit-to-write and command stages
clocks.generator: same-process monotonic origin for publish-to-application-ACK and publish-to-WS-receive round trips
clocks.cross_machine_one_way: unavailable unless clock synchronization method and error bound are measured and reported
clocks.sensor_measured_at: payload measurement time only; never use as commit/latency clock

measurement.missing_data: null/unavailable with reason for absent origin, process reset, missing scrape or incomparable instance; never replace missing values with zero
accounting_notes: Do not equate a publish attempt or backend Admit observation with broker wire packets.
Retries do not increase unique-offered count; duplicate commit does not increase new raw samples.
Raw rows are messages multiplied by their sample profile only when that message commits as new.
Payload byte counts are not TCP/TLS/broker wire bytes; shaper is downstream of broker/Paho ingress.
measurement.artifact_convention: planned runner output: run.json, metrics.csv, resources.csv plus workload results; fixed allowlisted metadata and long-form metric/bucket rows, no per-message payload capture

proposed_limits.qualification: proposed finite guardrails for future fixture runs; not implemented, effective, measured, or deployment settings
stop_on_first: pending message or byte bound reached
auth/TLS/membership failure or unexpected namespace delivery
proposed_limits.abort_semantics: stop creating new work first; signal owned generators idempotently; bounded drain only within the declared drain budget; join children and collect safe artifacts; retain original and cleanup errors separately; preserve pending/outbox state and report PARTIAL/FAILED with remaining counts; never clear pending or relabel an incomplete run PASS

phases.notes: Durations are proposed; provisioning, login, build and image pull are outside measured windows. Stop producers before drain. Only the E1 connection-ramp lane includes handshake ramp in its named measurement.

E4.ttl_pilot: real-time 600-second expiry NOT RUN unless actually performed; do not add a shortened production TTL

comparison_invariants: Within a comparison, use the same source/binary, image identity, security, quota, payload, durability, topology, worker/pool policy and phase schedule except the explicitly named factor.
Run one backend active at a time; reset/restart only the owned fixture with recorded state qualification.
Keep baseline mechanisms honest: per-message persistence is still COPY per message; retain auth, ACL, commit-before-ACK and control isolation.
Do not call pilot capacity acceptance, infer 10000-viewer/20000-message-per-second/62.5-ms claims, or combine historical runs into a new measured pair.
